name: cache-compact
description: Compacts an idle session just before its prompt cache expires.

ttlSeconds.title: Cache TTL (seconds)
ttlSeconds.description: Prompt-cache TTL: 300 for 5m, 3600 for 1h. Must be more than 20; otherwise 300.

marginSeconds.title: Margin (seconds)
marginSeconds.description: Compact this many seconds before the TTL ends. Must be at least 10 and less than the TTL; otherwise 30 (or half the TTL).

minTokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
minTokens.description: Do not compact when the context is smaller than this. Must be at least 1; otherwise 40000.
